name: nshamah
description: Create and manage Nshamah quizzes, knowledge banks and posts for education, from your AI assistant.

interface.longDescription: Nshamah is an education and quiz platform. Connect your account to build quizzes and knowledge banks, add and reorder questions, set cover images and visibility, and publish posts to your communities. Sign-in uses OAuth 2.1 with PKCE; you approve exactly which permissions each assistant gets and can revoke them any time. New banks are private drafts until you publish them.
defaultPrompt: Create a knowledge bank about a topic I choose
Add questions to one of my banks
Write and publish a post to my community

positive.prompt: Create a quiz on the solar system with 5 questions.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a private draft bank with 5 questions.

positive.prompt: Add a multiple-choice question about Mars to my solar system quiz.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the question to the existing bank.

positive.prompt: Move the last question in my solar system quiz to the top.
Make my solar system quiz public.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks for confirmation, then updates the bank visibility.

positive.prompt: Show stats for my solar system quiz.

negative.prompt: Create a Google Forms quiz about the solar system.
Write and publish a post on my Facebook page about exam tips.
Explain how many planets are in the solar system.
